theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_inf_reciprocal_polynomial_order
theorems.statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (s : F), Transcendental K s → ∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, v.ord s = 1 → (∀ c : Polynomial K, ¬ (Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ∣ c → v.ord (Polynomial.aeval s c) = 0) → ∀ a : Polynomial K, a ≠ 0 → v.ord (Polynomial.aeval s⁻¹ a) = -(a.natDegree : ℤ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
